notes: Firmus (Australian AI-factory/data-center operator, formerly a bitcoin miner) announced a fully-subscribed US$2B strategic equity round: follow-on capital from existing backers Coatue and NVIDIA, plus NEW capital from funds managed by Blackstone (Blackstone Tactical Opportunities and other Blackstone vehicles) and Jane Street. Per-investor split not disclosed, so amount_usd is blank and round_total_usd carries the full US$2B; post-money valuation >US$10.5B (up from ~US$3B four months earlier) sits in valuation_usd, not amount_usd. SK Telecom is spinning off its AI-data-center infrastructure business into a new company, SK Horizon, and has secured combined investment of KRW3.08tn (~US$2.23B) from KKR and the IMM Investment-Stonebridge Capital consortium. Upon completion of all phases, KKR will hold a 29% stake and the IMM/Stonebridge consortium 20%, with SK Telecom retaining 51% and management control. Per-investor dollar split not disclosed so amount_usd is blank; round_total_usd carries the combined US$2.23B and ownership_pct is KKR's own 29% stake. Spin-off targeted to complete Q1 2027 subject to shareholder/government approval -- this row records the signed investment agreement, not a completed close.

Funds managed by Blue Owl led a US$2.4B asset-backed compute-equipment financing for IREN Limited (vertically integrated AI Cloud/data-center platform): a US$1.2B senior secured term loan plus US$1.2B of senior secured notes, both priced at 9% and maturing 2.5 years after funding. Proceeds fund IREN's purchase of air-cooled NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPU infrastructure for its Mackenzie, British Columbia data-center campus, drawn in tranches alongside hardware delivery/commissioning. PIMCO was another backer of the facility; split between Blue Owl and PIMCO not disclosed so the full US$2.4B is recorded here.
